changed. The step waits for the pods again before it goes on.

[each seed document not yet in the repository]
from the dev pod (bin/polar-dev) the browser is on the operator's machine: this step pauses

credentials-agent-observer, and rollout status of statefulset polar-neo4j
(polar-graph), up to 10 minutes
pgrep for each svc/NAME, start the missing ones:
observer 8081, neo4j 7473, git 8443 (logs in files, restarted if they drop)
read ConfigMap polar-ca (this cluster's CA)
a stored ca.pem from another cluster? move the directory aside to
polar-admin.old-TIMESTAMP, delete nothing
just admin-bootstrap (skipped if bootstrap-admin.crt exists)
polar-ca to ca.pem
polar-admin-grant bootstrap: a CSR and the Kubernetes credential
bootstrap-admin.crt and .key (the key never left this machine)
just admin-provision U E (skipped if U.crt exists)
provision-account, signed with the bootstrap certificate:
permissions, capabilities (provision-account, grant, update-configuration,
run-command, update-policy, update-runtime, update-groups)
the account exists and the bootstrap certificate is spent
just admin-claim U E
claim: a keypair made here, a CSR sent
U.crt, U.key, U.chain.pem
wait_pods: polar-git-server, polar-scheduler-observer, polar-scheduler, credentials-agent
openssl x509 -ext subjectAltName on U.crt: the first DNS name is U's identity,
and the seed documents must name agents that exist
write targets/T/cluster-inputs.nuon (gitignored, tied to this cluster by the sha256 of its CA)
render again, so the git server's configuration names U
publish a second signed commit (deploy-repo.nu publish), its provenance.json names the
inputs file, its digest, the cluster and the values (flux.nu wait for Flux, or the apply loop)
git clone polar-schedules over mTLS with U's certificate
(through the 8443 forward, 6 tries 5 seconds apart: the forward may be reconnecting to a pod that was just replaced)
clone
the repository (a 403 here means the git server does not know U: seed refused_hint says where to look)
polar-sign runtime --agent A --section S --version N --body-file - --user U
(the body on standard input from seed.nu)
a signed document, written to permanent/A/S.dhall in the clone
git add, commit "feat(seed): ...", push (as U)
push: ACL by U's identity, append push-log.jsonl
RepoChanged on Cassini
pull polar-schedules (the observer), the scheduler hands each agent its documents
the signed policy document
verify the signature and the signer's capabilities (update-policy), apply and publish the policy
kubectl logs credentials-agent until it says the policy is published (3 minutes)
read the Librewolf certificate store (read-only): does it trust this CA
and hold U's current certificate?
PAUSE: close Librewolf so its store is not locked
press Enter
just user-cert-install U: remove the old Polar certificates,
import ca.pem and U's PKCS12 (nix-shell with nssTools)
read Secret polar-graph-pw
probe https://localhost:7473 with U's certificate and that password (retries for 2 minutes)
PAUSE: show the password from Secret neo4j-secret, ask to set it in the browser
accepted
kubectl -n polar get pods
egress probe: git ls-remote against a public repository from inside the
